query: SELECT c.phase::text AS "phase!", c.items AS "items!", c.completed AS "completed!", done.full_name AS "completed_by?", c.completed_at AS "completed_at?", checker.full_name AS "verified_by?" FROM ot_surgical_safety_checklists c LEFT JOIN users done ON done.id = c.completed_by LEFT JOIN users checker ON checker.id = c.verified_by WHERE c.booking_id = $1 AND c.tenant_id = $2 AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
